key.speaker: narrator
key.text: A font gone dry, and in the bowl a Key that makes no sound at all; the silence around it has edges. A sacristan rises from the pews with two husks.

choices.text: Take it whole. Kill the keeper.
Cinder. This is the one your thread ran to.
Break it. The Marshal wants it cold; cold enough is broken.

call.speaker: cinder
call.text: It was. It is lighter than I remembered. Take it, and take it whole; a broken Key is a door that will not shut.
